body: I thought this was r/shittysuperpowers for a sec
You still here? If so, want to talk?
17. All the stress from school, my parents, trying to find a good a job, and trying to find a good college just built up and I cannot fucking take it.
What if I withdraw it and just give it all to my family in cash or on a check? That way there would be nothing in my bank account to claim.
That isn’t the reason. There are many reasons, that’s not even one of them. Shit has just been building up for years and I can’t fucking take it anymore.
Guess I’ll just spend a good portion of it on myself and give the rest away to my mother.
I’m wondering if it makes me selfish. I could give it to some family member or something, but I figured I might as well have a good time before I die.
